paras: The grey-headed fruit dove or gray-headed fruit dove  (Ptilinopus hyogastrus, Ptilinopus hyogastra or Ptilinopus hyogaster) is a species of bird in the family Columbidae. It is endemic to the northern Moluccas.
Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.
It is mostly green except for a grey head, red eyes and black yellow-tipped beak.
